prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist, but **Zhao Dental (Dr. Shirley Zhao)** looks like a strong option for a routine checkup and cleaning: its Pleasanton office reports a **4.8 rating from 100+ reviews**, offers exams and cleanings, and says it accepts many major insurance plans.

**Zhao Dental**  
1400 Santa Rita Road, Suite L, Pleasanton  
(925) 462-7117  
[Website](https://pleasanton-dentist.com/)

Another option to compare is **Infinite Smile Dental**, which offers preventive exams and cleanings and lists a new-patient exam, X-rays, and cleaning special. Before booking, confirm the current price, whether your insurance is accepted, and whether the appointment includes a standard cleaning—some patients need a different type of cleaning.
